reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin centered on autonomous agent orchestration across multiple turns, with durable checkpoints and cancellation or round-limit controls; GitHub discovery, AI-assisted plugin installation, and workspace registration are secondary interface features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带轮次预算、检查点恢复和取消控制的自主智能体循环，并附带 GitHub 插件发现、AI 安装及工作区注册界面。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with a bounded, checkpointed, and cancellable autonomous agent loop, plus interfaces for GitHub plugin discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace registration.

capabilities: Runs autonomous multi-turn agent loops until completion, cancellation, or a round limit
Persists and restores loop checkpoints using local JSON files
Searches GitHub repositories through a sidebar interface
Starts a new session that can perform AI-assisted plugin installation
Registers workspaces from user-provided filesystem paths
Provides responsive browser UI for search, installation, and workspace management
